sample_id.title: Sample identifier
sample_id.description: Unique identifier of the ECHOREPO soil sample.

timestamp_utc.title: Sampling timestamp
timestamp_utc.description: Date and time associated with collection of the soil sample, expressed in UTC where available.

lat.title: Latitude
lat.description: Latitude of the sample location in decimal degrees using WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

lon.title: Longitude
lon.description: Longitude of the sample location in decimal degrees using WGS 84 (EPSG:4326).

country_code.title: Country code
country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code associated with the sample location.

location_accuracy_m.title: Location accuracy
location_accuracy_m.description: Estimated horizontal accuracy of the recorded sample coordinates, in metres.

uploaded_at.title: Upload timestamp
uploaded_at.description: Date and time at which the source data were uploaded or ingested into ECHOREPO.

uploaded_by.title: Uploaded by
uploaded_by.description: Identifier of the account or process that uploaded the source data.

source_file.title: Source file
source_file.description: Name or reference of the source file from which the row was derived.

data_source.title: Data source
data_source.description: Source system or workflow from which the canonical record was derived.

collected_by.title: Collected by
collected_by.description: Identifier or category of the participant or process responsible for collecting the sample data.

licence.title: Licence
licence.description: Licence statement associated with the row or source data.

qa_status.title: Quality-assurance status
qa_status.description: ECHOREPO quality-assurance status assigned to the canonical sample record.

parameter_name.title: Parameter name
parameter_name.description: Internal ECHOREPO name of the observed or measured parameter.

parameter_label.title: Parameter label
parameter_label.description: Human-readable label of the observed or measured parameter.

parameter_uri.title: Observed-property URI
parameter_uri.description: Persistent URI identifying the property that was observed or measured.

parameter_value.title: Parameter value
parameter_value.description: Recorded result of the observation or measurement. Its interpretation depends on parameter_name or parameter_uri.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Human-readable unit in which the parameter value is expressed.

unit_uri.title: Unit URI
unit_uri.description: Persistent URI identifying the unit of measurement.

procedure_uri.title: Measurement-procedure URI
procedure_uri.description: Persistent URI identifying the procedure used to obtain the result, where available.

subject_uri.title: Feature-of-interest URI
subject_uri.description: Persistent URI identifying the subject or feature of interest of the observation.

method_label.title: Method label
method_label.description: Human-readable name of the method or procedure used to obtain the value.

marker.title: Molecular marker
marker.description: Molecular marker or assay target used for the biodiversity observation, for example 16S or ITS.

otu_id.title: Operational taxonomic unit identifier
otu_id.description: Identifier of the operational taxonomic unit in the source biodiversity table.

count.title: Sequence or observation count
count.description: Count associated with the operational taxonomic unit for the sample.

taxa.title: Taxonomic assignment
taxa.description: Taxonomic assignment associated with the operational taxonomic unit, as supplied by the source biodiversity workflow.

filename.title: File name
filename.description: Name of the image or other related digital file.

image_url.title: Image URL
image_url.description: URL from which the sample image can be accessed.

content_url.title: Content URL
content_url.description: URL from which the related digital object can be accessed.

image_type.title: Image type
image_type.description: ECHOREPO category describing the role or type of the sample image.

caption.title: Image caption
caption.description: Human-readable caption or comment associated with the sample image.

samples.csv.title: ECHOREPO canonical soil samples
samples.csv.description: Canonical sample-level ECHOREPO records, including identifiers, sampling time, location and selected soil observations.

ph.title: Soil pH
ph.description: Soil pH value recorded for the sample.
ph.method: ECHO citizen-science or laboratory workflow, as represented in the canonical source data.

soil_organic_matter_estimate_pct.title: Soil organic carbon
soil_organic_matter_estimate_pct.description: Soil organic carbon content associated with the sample, expressed as a percentage where populated.

earthworms_count.title: Earthworm abundance
earthworms_count.description: Number of earthworms observed in the ECHO citizen-science assessment.

pollutants_count.title: Observed pollutant indicators
pollutants_count.description: Count of pollutant or contamination indicators recorded for the sample.

contamination_debris.title: Debris contamination observation
contamination_debris.description: Recorded observation of debris contamination at the sampling location.

contamination_plastic.title: Plastic contamination observation
contamination_plastic.description: Recorded observation of plastic contamination at the sampling location.

contamination_other_orig.title: Other contamination observation, original language
contamination_other_orig.description: Free-text description of other contamination in the language submitted by the participant.

contamination_other_en.title: Other contamination observation, English
contamination_other_en.description: English representation of the free-text description of other contamination.

soil_structure_orig.title: Soil structure, original language
soil_structure_orig.description: Soil-structure observation in the language submitted by the participant.

soil_structure_en.title: Soil structure, English
soil_structure_en.description: English representation of the soil-structure observation.

soil_texture_orig.title: Soil texture, original language
soil_texture_orig.description: Soil-texture observation in the language submitted by the participant.

soil_texture_en.title: Soil texture, English
soil_texture_en.description: English representation of the soil-texture observation.

observations_orig.title: Additional observations, original language
observations_orig.description: Additional free-text observations submitted by the participant in the original language.

observations_en.title: Additional observations, English
observations_en.description: English representation of additional free-text observations.

metals_info_orig.title: Metals information, original language
metals_info_orig.description: Participant-provided information concerning metals or potential metal contamination in the original language.

metals_info_en.title: Metals information, English
metals_info_en.description: English representation of participant-provided information concerning metals or potential metal contamination.

sample_parameters.csv.title: ECHOREPO sample parameters
sample_parameters.csv.description: Long-form parameter observations and measurements associated with ECHOREPO samples. The parameter_uri and procedure_uri columns carry row-level semantic identifiers when available.

sample_images.csv.title: ECHOREPO sample images
sample_images.csv.description: Image resources and image metadata associated with ECHOREPO soil samples.

sample_biodiversity.csv.title: ECHOREPO sample biodiversity observations
sample_biodiversity.csv.description: Operational taxonomic units, taxonomic assignments and counts associated with ECHOREPO soil samples.
